propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate maintained the billing rules and merchant rate cards in the billing system, logging each change with the contract amendment reference.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the rule and rate-card maintenance directly.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate coordinated billing disputes with account management and collections and recorded who owned which part of a dispute.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the dispute coordination and the recorded boundaries.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate owned the monthly merchant billing run, approved billing credits under a delegated limit of 15,000 and led the monthly billing review.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the approval log and the reference state the ownership, the limit and the review leadership.

expectedGap: Hand-over conditions after each billing run are only partly documented in the review record.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the ownership as documented: credits within the 15,000 limit and the billing review; larger credits went to the head of finance operations.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask how hand-over conditions were recorded after each billing run.
